items.name: Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32S3
items.description: 21 x 17.8 mm native-USB XIAO module; onboard USB-C is the product power/data port.
required_user_evidence: Procurement reminder only: record distributor and order number when purchased.
items.selection_reason: ESP32-S3 is supported by Espressif's TinyUSB-based USB Audio Class device library and provides ADC capture, the SPI display interface and eleven exposed GPIOs.

items.name: LT225C7-C08-03 2.25-inch color LCD
items.description: 76RGB x 284, ST7789P3, 4-line SPI, 8-pin 0.5 mm FPC, 17.9 x 62.5 x 2.36 mm.
items.package: 17.9 x 62.5 x 2.36 mm LCD module with 8-pin 0.5 mm FPC tail
required_user_evidence: Procurement reminder only: preserve the exact seller/order link and panel revision.
items.selection_reason: Exact user-selected panel; supplied datasheet pages 4-8 establish dimensions, active area, pinout, 2.5-3.3 V logic supply and backlight limits.

items.name: Amphenol SFV8R-2STE1HLF
items.description: 8-position 0.5 mm pitch horizontal flip-lock top-contact FPC connector for 0.3 mm FPC, 1.8 mm board height.
items.package: SMD, 8P, P0.5 mm, horizontal top contact

physical_interface.pin1_position: verify from the supplier footprint preview after orienting the cable opening toward the left edge
evidence_refs: user statement: display tail is front-contact
LCSC C2992524 parameters: 8P, 0.5 mm, top contact, 0.3 mm FPC

items.selection_reason: The display seller confirmed a front-contact tail. Wrapping the tail around the left PCB edge onto the back makes its exposed contacts face away from the carrier PCB, so a bottom-side top-contact connector is required. C2992524 is an exact in-stock 8P/0.5 mm/0.3 mm top-contact match; Extended is used because no credible Basic-library match was found.

items.name: ZILLTEK ZTS6216
items.description: User-specified bottom-port omnidirectional analog MEMS microphone, 1.5-3.6 V, 65 dBA SNR, -38 dBV/Pa, 2.75 x 1.85 x 1.0 mm.
items.package: SMD-4P, 2.75 x 1.85 mm, bottom acoustic port
items.selection_reason: Exact microphone mandated by the user; supplier and datasheet evidence confirm analog output, 65 dBA SNR, pins OUT/GND/GND/VDD and a 0.50 mm bottom acoustic port.

items.name: Texas Instruments TLV9061IDBVR
items.description: 10 MHz rail-to-rail single op amp for approximately 101 V/V non-inverting ZTS6216 gain and ADC drive.
items.selection_reason: 1.8-5.5 V operation, 10 MHz GBW, rail-to-rail I/O and 10 nV/sqrtHz input noise provide sufficient voice-band gain from the analog MEMS microphone into the ESP32-S3 ADC.

items.name: HanElectricity CPG151101D05 MX-compatible red linear switch
items.description: MX-compatible 45 gf red linear switch installed without solder into the paired CPG151101S11-16 hot-swap socket.
items.package: MX-compatible PCB-mount switch, 2 contact pins plus center/locating posts
required_user_evidence: Procurement reminder only: this removable through-hole switch is purchased separately and inserted after PCBA.
items.selection_reason: User requested MX switches and the exact CPG151101S11-16 socket. CPG151101D05 preserves the prior red linear preference; supplier evidence lists 45 gf force, 2 mm actuation and current stock.

items.name: HanElectricity CPG151101S11-16 MX hot-swap socket
items.description: Bottom-side SMD hot-swap socket requested by the user for MX-compatible switches.
items.package: 14.5 x 5.9 mm bottom-side SMD MX hot-swap socket
required_user_evidence: Placement reminder: verify the JLC assembly orientation against the bottom-side pin-1 mark before ordering PCBA.
items.selection_reason: Exact user-selected CPG151101S11-16 identity. Supplier detail confirms C41430893, JLC Extended-library status and current stock; the reviewed local geometry follows the supplier drawing.

items.name: Blank black 1u MX keycap
items.description: MX cross-stem 1u keycap with a maximum 18 x 18 mm face envelope.
required_user_evidence: Procurement reminder: seller must confirm an MX cross stem and maximum 18 x 18 mm face envelope.
items.selection_reason: Required by the user-selected MX switch/socket system; legends remain on the display.

items.name: Samsung CL05B104KO5NNNC 100 nF 16 V X7R 0402
items.description: MIC1 and U2 VDD decoupling, display VDD decoupling and LCD reset RC capacitor.
items.selection_reason: Local microphone/op-amp bypass plus display and reset support; Basic library minimizes assembly cost.

items.name: Samsung CL05A105KA5NQNC 1 uF 25 V 0402
items.description: ZTS6216 AC coupling and 1.65 V virtual-ground filtering.
items.selection_reason: Defines the low-frequency coupling and stabilizes the half-supply microphone bias node.

items.name: Samsung CL05B103KB5NNNC 10 nF 50 V 0402
items.description: With R8=1 kOhm forms an approximately 15.9 kHz ADC input low-pass filter.
items.selection_reason: Provides first-order voice-band anti-alias filtering before the XIAO ADC.

items.name: UNI-ROYAL 0402WGF1003TCE 100 kOhm 1% 0402
items.description: Virtual-ground divider, AC-input bias and preamp feedback network.
items.selection_reason: Creates 1.65 V bias and approximately 101 V/V non-inverting gain with the 1 kOhm gain resistor.

items.name: UNI-ROYAL 0402WGF1001TCE 1 kOhm 1% 0402
items.description: Preamp gain leg and ADC low-pass series resistor.
items.selection_reason: Sets the preamp gain and isolates the op-amp from the ADC filter capacitance.

items.name: UNI-ROYAL 0402WGF1002TCE 10 kOhm 1% 0402
items.description: Pulls LCD RESET_N to 3.3 V; C3 creates power-on reset delay.
items.selection_reason: Hardware reset avoids consuming the final XIAO GPIO.

items.name: UNI-ROYAL 0402WGF0000TCE 0 Ohm 0402
items.description: Zero-ohm links for locally routed LCD_VDD, LCD_GND, MIC_VDD, MIC_AC and microphone-ground branches.
items.selection_reason: Creates locally routed LCD and microphone branches so constrained pads join board-wide rails only after a short explicit escape trace.

items.name: UNI-ROYAL 1206W4F270JT5E 27 Ohm 1% 250 mW 1206
items.description: Feeds LCD LEDA from USB VBUS; calculated current is about 57-91 mA over 4.75-5.25 V USB and 2.8-3.2 V LED range, below the 120 mA panel maximum.
required_user_evidence: Procurement reminder only: confirm an exact 27 Ohm, 1%, at least 0.25 W 1206 resistor before ordering.
items.selection_reason: Static always-on backlight avoids an unavailable AW9364 while remaining inside the panel's stated current limit; no brightness control is required.

alternatives.reason: Native USB alternative, but ESP32-S3 already meets the ADC and UAC requirements.
Lower-bandwidth backup op amp; TLV9061 offers lower noise, more gain-bandwidth margin and lower supplier price.
Lower-cost 8P 0.5 mm bottom-contact alternative requiring separate footprint and contact-orientation qualification.
Rejected for the confirmed front-contact display tail because it is a bottom-contact connector; retain only as an alternative for a different tail contact orientation.
Previous Choc V2 red selection rejected for this revision because no verified compatible hot-swap socket abstraction was available.

supply_risks.item: XIAO, display, switches and keycaps are externally procured
supply_risks.mitigation: Exact electrical/mechanical identities are fixed; record seller links at ordering time.

supply_risks.item: ZTS6216, TLV9061 and Amphenol top-contact FPC connector are JLC Extended parts
supply_risks.mitigation: Accept Extended placement cost; do not substitute Basic lookalikes without footprint and circuit revalidation.

supply_risks.item: Analog microphone path uses the ESP32-S3 internal ADC
supply_risks.mitigation: Prototype-validate noise floor, clipping and 48 kHz capture; preserve the TLV9061 gain and 15.9 kHz anti-alias filter as the baseline.

supply_risks.item: Backlight uses a resistor rather than constant-current IC
supply_risks.mitigation: The 27 Ohm value bounds current below the 120 mA maximum across stated USB and LED voltage ranges; brightness variation is accepted for this revision.

supply_risks.item: CPG151101S11-16 is a bottom-side JLC Extended hot-swap socket
supply_risks.mitigation: Use exact LCSC C41430893 and verify bottom-side placement rotation against the PCB pin-1 mark; install removable CPG151101D05 MX switches only after PCBA.
